title: open-multi-agent/open-multi-agent
claim: open-multi-agent/open-multi-agent — TypeScript AI agent orchestration framework with dynamic workflows. Describe the goal, not the graph: a coordinator plan
why_good: 'Describe the goal, not the graph' — a TS framework that auto-plans multi-agent workflows, a genuinely different DX from graph-wiring tools.
value: Monetize as the hosted control plane: run/observe/route agent workflows for teams, usage-based + enterprise.
risk: Orchestration is brutally crowded (LangGraph, CrewAI, the vendors); auto-planning must clearly beat explicit graphs.
pick_reason: The framework offers a clear product for developers to build and monetize AI agent orchestration solutions.

zh.claim: open-multi-agent/open-multi-agent —— TypeScript 的 AI agent 编排框架,动态工作流:描述目标,而非画图。
zh.why_good: "描述目标,而非画图"——自动规划多 agent 工作流的 TS 框架,和手工连图的工具相比 DX 确实不同。
zh.value: 做成托管控制平面变现:替团队跑/观测/路由 agent 工作流,按量 + 企业版。
zh.risk: 编排极挤(LangGraph、CrewAI、各厂商);自动规划必须明显强过手画图才能赢。
